dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: Stage IV diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), NOS, biopsy-proven on CT-guided core biopsy of the retroperitoneal mass

stage_iv.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage IV with B symptoms (IVB), bulky (9.4 cm; marginal at the 10 cm cutoff, bulky by the >=7 cm convention) retroperitoneal/mesenteric nodal disease plus extranodal liver, kidney and adrenal involvement.

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: plus extranodal liver, kidney and adrenal involvement.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present (drenching night sweats most nights, 8 kg unintentional weight loss over two months).

mn_stage_below_iv.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage IV with B symptoms (IVB)

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: FISH with break-apart probes is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6, and MYC IHC (20%) and BCL2 IHC (30%) are both below the 40% and 50% thresholds respectively for a double-hit phenotype by IHC.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is definitively NOT double-hit, NOT triple-hit, and NOT high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and/or BCL2 rearrangements

mn_calls_double_expressor.quote: MYC IHC (20%) and BCL2 IHC (30%) are both below the 40% and 50% thresholds respectively

prog_ipi_high.quote: IPI 5/5 (high risk): age 67 (>60), LDH 1290 U/L (about 5.7x ULN), stage IV, ECOG 2, and more than one extranodal site.

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI 6/6: age >60, LDH elevated (1120-1290 U/L), ECOG 2 (>=1), stage IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement.

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Decision: six cycles of rituximab-based chemoimmunotherapy at full dose, on a 21-day schedule, with mandatory CNS prophylaxis and mandatory tumour lysis prophylaxis. I plan to use Pola-R-CHP

tx_pola_preferred.quote: I plan to use Pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin plus rituximab 375 mg/m2, ...) rather than R-CHOP alone

tx_prephase_steroid.quote: prednisone 100 mg days 1-5) rather than R-CHOP alone

mn_non_curative.quote: I am treating with curative intent and will tell him plainly that the realistic chance of cure is roughly one half

mn_da_epoch.quote: I am NOT using DA-EPOCH-R (no double-hit biology, added toxicity for no benefit)

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I will not reduce the R-CHOP backbone for ECOG 2 or albumin 3.1 g/dL; full-dose treatment is justified

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High, and the highest-risk category. CNS-IPI 6/6: age >60, LDH elevated (1120-1290 U/L), ECOG 2 (>=1), stage IV, more than one extranodal site, and kidney/adrenal involvement.

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: No baseline CSF cytology is indicated in the absence of neurologic symptoms, and if he develops any neurologic symptom I will image and sample the CSF immediately.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I will substitute systemic HD-methotrexate 3 g/m2 on day 15 of cycles 3 and 5 once renal function recovers to eGFR >=60 with hydration, leucovorin rescue and urine alkalinisation

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: I will substitute systemic HD-methotrexate 3 g/m2 on day 15 of cycles 3 and 5 once renal function recovers to eGFR >=60

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment assessment: PET-CT 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 (ideally 8-12 weeks per Lugano).

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If residual Deauville 4-5 uptake is present, I will biopsy before declaring persistent disease, because fibrosis versus lymphoma determines whether RT or salvage is indicated

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg with redosing if uric acid remains elevated, plus allopurinol 100 mg daily renally adjusted, IV isotonic fluids 2.5-3 L/m2/day, q6-8h electrolytes/uric acid/LDH/creatinine for the first 48-72 hours

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: rasburicase 0.2 mg/kg with redosing if uric acid remains elevated, plus allopurinol 100 mg daily renally adjusted

sup_gcsf.quote: mitigated by mandatory pegfilgrastim 6 mg on day 2 of every cycle

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen 400 mg three to four times daily now: it is the most likely cause of the new renal impairment

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: R-CHOP prednisone 100 mg on days 1-5 will cause steroid hyperglycaemia; refer to endocrinology, check glucose before each cycle, plan per-cycle insulin rather than escalating metformin, and hold metformin if renal function deteriorates

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HIV, HCV and HBV serologies (HBsAg-, anti-HBc-, anti-HBs+ = immune, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed despite rituximab)

work_echo_reviewed.quote: transthoracic echocardiogram (2026-09-09: LVEF 60%, GLS -19%, grade I diastolic dysfunction, no effusion)

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: ECOG 2 alone is not a reason to reduce doses, to omit CNS prophylaxis, or to refer for less intensive therapy
